#  Hostr

> semantic-release: angular

- [ Hostr](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/readme.md):  Hostr
- [AI](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/ai/readme.md): Hostr's AI surface is the MCP server that lets an agent search listings, manage a Hostr session, create or edit listings, negotiate reservations, handle payments, upload images, and inspect trips/bookings through the same SDK paths used by the app.
- [Infrastructure](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/infrastructure/readme.md): Infrastructure is split into two Terraform stacks:
- [App](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/app/readme.md): codecov
- [Escrow](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/escrow/readme.md): Hostr uses NMDK's escrow drivers for reservation settlement. NMDK owns on-chain funding, payment-proof verification, swap recovery, and settlement; Hostr connects these mechanisms to its booking flow and MCP tools.

## AI

- [Hostr Daemon](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/ai/daemon/readme.md): The Hostr daemon is the Dart process behind the MCP server. It is not the public HTTP service. It is a local child process that the Node MCP bridge starts and talks to over stdio.

## Guides

- [Getting started](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/guides/getting_started.md): Install dependencies: dnsmasq and route hostr.development to docker.
- [Release Guide](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/guides/release.md): This document covers the full release lifecycle: branching, PRs, versioning, CI secrets, and deploying staging and production builds to the App Store and Play Store.

## Infrastructure

- [Dart and Flutter dependency audit](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/infrastructure/dart-dependencies.md): Verified 2026-09-16 UTC against official pub.dev package metadata and the Flutter stable repository. The latest stable SDK is Flutter 3.47.4 / Dart 3.13.3, revision 9584c6713b324636289d067944a46fd6b49df14b.
- [NMDK / Hostr refactor changes](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/infrastructure/nmdk-refactor-changes.md): Hostr is a consumer of NMDK payment drivers and canonical models. This is a pre-launch cutover: disposable development deployments and state can be recreated without a v6 compatibility or data-migration layer.
- [Payment driver boundary](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/infrastructure/payment-drivers.md): NMDK owns EVM escrow and Lightning swap mechanisms. Hostr supplies application identity, Lightning payment access, preferences and Nostr event subscriptions.
- [Shared driver contracts](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/infrastructure/driver-contracts.md): The TypeScript and Dart EVM drivers share their external wire contracts through existing generators. Runtime orchestration remains native to each language.
- [Tailscale](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/infrastructure/tailscale.md): The local dev stack uses Tailscale to make services running on your dev Mac (via Docker) accessible from other devices — primarily an iPhone for real-device testing.

## Source

### Ai

#### Hostr MCP Server

- [Hostr MCP Server](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/source/ai/mcp-server/readme.md): The Hostr MCP server exposes typed Hostr actions over MCP and delegates Hostr SDK work to the Dart hostr-daemon. The action catalog in hostr_cli/lib/src/actions/hostr_actions.dart is the source of truth for MCP tool names, input JSON schemas, generated TypeScript types, and workflow documentation.
- [ChatGPT App Submission Prep](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/source/ai/mcp-server/chatgpt_submission.md): This checklist is scoped to making the production Hostr MCP server review-ready for the ChatGPT Apps Directory.

## Specifications

- [NIP-XX](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/specifications/accommodation.md): Accommodation Listing Profile for NIP-99 Marketplace Listings
- [NIP-XX](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/specifications/arbitration.md): draft optional
- [NIP-XX](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/specifications/auctions.md): Marketplace Auctions
- [NIP-XX](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/specifications/listings.md): NIP-99 Marketplace Listing Extension
- [NIP-XX](https://sudonym-btc.github.io/hostr/specifications/orders.md): Orders
